line_1_employee_count.rationale: EmployeeCnt directly corresponds to Line 1 headcount of employees who received wages.

line_2_wages_tips_other.rationale: WagesAmt corresponds to Line 2 total wages, tips, and other compensation.

line_3_federal_income_tax_withheld.rationale: FederalIncomeTaxWithheldAmt directly corresponds to Line 3 federal income tax withheld.

line_4_no_wages_subject_to_ss_medicare.rationale: WagesNotSubjToSSMedcrTaxInd is the indicator for Line 4 checkbox that no wages are subject to SS/Medicare tax.

line_5a_ss_wages.rationale: SocialSecurityTaxCashWagesAmt under SocialSecurityWageAndTaxGrp corresponds to Line 5a Column 1 taxable Social Security wages.

line_5a_ss_tax.rationale: SocialSecurityTaxAmt under SocialSecurityWageAndTaxGrp corresponds to Line 5a Column 2 Social Security tax amount.

line_5b_ss_tips.rationale: TaxableSocSecTipsAmt under SocialSecurityTipsAndTaxGrp corresponds to Line 5b Column 1 taxable Social Security tips.

line_5b_ss_tips_tax.rationale: TaxOnSocialSecurityTipsAmt under SocialSecurityTipsAndTaxGrp corresponds to Line 5b Column 2 Social Security tax on tips.

line_5c_medicare_wages.rationale: TaxableMedicareWagesTipsAmt under MedicareWageTipsAndTaxGrp corresponds to Line 5c Column 1 taxable Medicare wages and tips.

line_5c_medicare_tax.rationale: TaxOnMedicareWagesTipsAmt under MedicareWageTipsAndTaxGrp corresponds to Line 5c Column 2 Medicare tax amount.

line_5d_additional_medicare_wages.rationale: TxblWageTipsSubjAddnlMedcrAmt under AddnlMedicareWageTipsAndTaxGrp corresponds to Line 5d Column 1 wages subject to Additional Medicare Tax.

line_5d_additional_medicare_tax.rationale: TaxOnWageTipsSubjAddnlMedcrAmt under AddnlMedicareWageTipsAndTaxGrp corresponds to Line 5d Column 2 Additional Medicare Tax withheld.

line_5e_total_ss_medicare_tax.rationale: TotalSSMdcrTaxAmt corresponds to Line 5e total Social Security and Medicare taxes.

line_5f_section_3121q_notice_and_demand.rationale: TaxOnUnreportedTips3121qAmt corresponds to Line 5f tax under Section 3121(q) Notice and Demand.

line_6_total_taxes_before_adjustments.rationale: TotalTaxBeforeAdjustmentAmt corresponds to Line 6 total taxes before adjustments.

line_7_fractions_of_cents_adjustment.rationale: CurrentQtrFractionsCentsAmt corresponds to Line 7 current quarter fractions of cents adjustment.

line_8_sick_pay_adjustment.rationale: CurrentQuarterSickPaymentAmt corresponds to Line 8 current quarter sick pay adjustment.

line_9_tips_group_term_life_adjustment.rationale: CurrQtrTipGrpTermLifeInsAdjAmt corresponds to Line 9 adjustment for tips and group-term life insurance.

line_10_total_taxes_after_adjustments.rationale: TotalTaxAfterAdjustmentAmt corresponds to Line 10 total taxes after adjustments.

line_11a_qualified_small_business_resear.rationale: PayrollTaxCreditAmt is the best available match for the qualified small business payroll tax credit for research activities (Line 11a).

line_11b_nonrefundable_sick_family_leave.rationale: No canonical element for the COVID-era nonrefundable sick/family leave credit (Line 11b) is present in the candidate list.

line_11c_reserved.rationale: No canonical element for the reserved Line 11c is present in the candidate list.

line_11d_nonrefundable_employee_retentio.rationale: No canonical element for the nonrefundable Employee Retention Credit (Line 11d) is present in the candidate list.

line_11e_nonrefundable_cobra_premium_cre.rationale: No canonical element for the nonrefundable COBRA premium assistance credit (Line 11e) is present in the candidate list.

line_11f_number_of_individuals_cobra.rationale: No canonical element for the count of individuals provided COBRA premium assistance (Line 11f) is present in the candidate list.

line_11g_total_nonrefundable_credits.rationale: No canonical element for total nonrefundable credits (Line 11g) is present in the candidate list.

line_12_total_taxes_after_credits.rationale: TotalTaxAmt corresponds to Line 12 total taxes after adjustments and nonrefundable credits.

line_13a_total_deposits.rationale: TotalTaxDepositAmt corresponds to Line 13a total deposits made for the quarter.

line_13b_deferred_employer_ss_tax.rationale: No canonical element for CARES Act deferred employer SS tax (Line 13b) is present in the candidate list.

line_13c_refundable_sick_family_leave_cr.rationale: No canonical element for the COVID-era refundable sick/family leave credit (Line 13c) is present in the candidate list.

line_13d_reserved.rationale: No canonical element for the reserved Line 13d is present in the candidate list.

line_13e_refundable_employee_retention_c.rationale: No canonical element for the refundable Employee Retention Credit (Line 13e) is present in the candidate list.

line_13f_refundable_cobra_premium_credit.rationale: No canonical element for the refundable COBRA premium assistance credit (Line 13f) is present in the candidate list.

line_13g_total_deposits_and_credits.rationale: No canonical element for total deposits and refundable credits (Line 13g) is present in the candidate list.

line_14_balance_due.rationale: BalanceDueAmt corresponds to Line 14 balance due amount.

line_15_overpayment.rationale: OverpaidAmt under OverpaymentGrp corresponds to Line 15 overpayment amount.

line_15_apply_to_next_return.rationale: ApplyOverpaymentNextReturnInd under OverpaymentGrp corresponds to the Line 15 checkbox to apply overpayment to next return.

line_15_send_refund.rationale: RefundOverpaymentInd under OverpaymentGrp corresponds to the Line 15 checkbox to receive overpayment as a refund.

deposit_schedule.rationale: The blueprint bundles monthly depositor, semiweekly depositor, and less-than-$2500 options into one category field; canonical schema splits these into MonthlyScheduleDepositorInd (idx 17), SemiweeklyScheduleDepositorInd (idx 29), and TotalTaxLessThanLimitAmtInd (idx 40) — blueprint should be refactored into three separate boolean fields.

line_16_monthly_tax_liability_month1.rationale: TaxLiabilityMonth1Amt under MonthlyScheduleDepositorGrp corresponds to Line 16 Month 1 tax liability.

line_16_monthly_tax_liability_month2.rationale: TaxLiabilityMonth2Amt under MonthlyScheduleDepositorGrp corresponds to Line 16 Month 2 tax liability.

line_16_monthly_tax_liability_month3.rationale: TaxLiabilityMonth3Amt under MonthlyScheduleDepositorGrp corresponds to Line 16 Month 3 tax liability.

line_16_total_liability.rationale: TotalQuarterTaxLiabilityAmt under MonthlyScheduleDepositorGrp corresponds to Line 16 total quarterly tax liability.

line_17_business_closed.rationale: FutureFilingNotRequiredInd under BusinessClosedGrp corresponds to the Line 17 business closed checkbox.

line_17_final_date_wages_paid.rationale: FinalWagesPaidDt under BusinessClosedGrp corresponds to Line 17 final date wages were paid.

line_18_seasonal_employer.rationale: SeasonalEmployerInd corresponds to the Line 18 seasonal employer checkbox.
